name: equipment-inspection-deferral
description: Run backend/ and frontend/ from the repo root. Each app keeps its own package-lock.json (CI installs them separately).

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.ci: npm run ci:backend && npm run ci:frontend
scripts.ci:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm run build:backend && npm run test:backend
scripts.ci:frontend: npm run lint:frontend && npm run build:frontend
